title: Stock door, painted wood, single
description: The wooden door of Talsik Backlot. Use opens it away from you and closes it again. It is the game's real door, copied from the stock map into yours (Edit > Preferences > Real stock scripted objects, on by default). With that switch off it is built from the stock door's own parts (model, sounds, timing, prompt words) and a script.
author: IW8 Radiant
pivot: hinge, floor level; the door leaf runs 52 units along +X

fallback.note: stock door built as a scripted door from stock parts (Real stock scripted objects is off in Preferences)
